name: s77-quality-gate-perl-timeout-kills-group
setup_commands: chmod +x minbin/cargo && for t in bash sh perl sleep git dirname basename tr date mkdir tail head sed grep cat awk env rm mv cp; do p=$(command -v "$t") && ln -s "$p" "minbin/$t"; done; true
notes: No python3, timeout or gtimeout on PATH, so the time limit falls back to a perl alarm. The alarm ended only the shell; the cargo it started ran on (9s against a 2s limit) and held the output open. The perl fallback now runs the check in its own process group and kills the group.
